rayRule.origin: receiver point + actual .018m * interpolated geometric vertex normal in receiver local space, then world transform
rayRule.direction: negative geometric interpolated normal, inverse-transpose transformed to world and normalized; flat faces use face normal
rayRule.accept: first directed source intersection in world space has distance strictly less than actual .045m
rayRule.furtherRayQueries: Nearest-source point on each miss only; no reverse ray, direction/distance sweep, changed bake or cage

panelDefinition.newGusset: barycentric weight on original changed target vertex IDs, via retained regional vertex lineage; support label, not new anatomy inference

outputs: One compressed NPZ: per-covered-pixel rays, exact measured first hits/status, source UV/original face lineage, actual baked values, exact raw black/alpha atlas masks, regional/full-target UV sample multiplicity, new-gusset support
One report: regional counts/distances, black-vs-ray confusion counts, cross-panel and normal orientation evidence, canonical/file preservation
limitations: Original dense need not enclose body. Failed OUTSIDE native is never read. No moving/player/material acceptance.
Measurements use the saved original evaluated regional source and receiver from the actual failed probe. No source/target geometry or bake setting changes.

The ray setup and strict acceptance mirror official Blender v5.2.1. Python mathutils BVH and barycentric interior rasterization are separate implementations, not byte-identical Blender zspan/BVH. UV samples use its (-.501,-.502) pixel offset and last-triangle ownership; marked near-edge samples may differ. Actual packed baked PNG black/alpha masks remain exact.
UV multiplicities measure interior pixel-centre overlap at1024, not a continuous UV area proof. Intentionally unbaked legs/background are excluded from regional ray counts.

Nearest-source point direction/offset on a miss is evidence about that nearest point only, not proof that every source surface lies behind the ray. No first-intersection is kept separate from beyond45mm.
Original albedo bilinear-repeat samples are a diagnostic; Cycles texture derivatives/filtering may differ. Hit source UV, original face ID and actual baked values are retained.
No authored cage is justified until actual measurements show which misses are distance, direction, opening/cut, UV ownership or unmatched new gusset. Parent alone judges the next single correction.
